Ranks Montgomery census tracts by 2025 code violations per 1,000 residents using pre-aggregated tract counts joined to CDC PLACES total population, with raw counts and denominator retained for verification.
sql:
WITH violations AS (
  SELECT geoid, SUM(n) AS code_violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_c36acd' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
population AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_c36acd_m2_cdc
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(v.code_violations, 0) AS code_violations,
       p.totalpopulation,
       CASE WHEN p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
            THEN (COALESCE(v.code_violations, 0) / p.totalpopulation) * 1000
       END AS code_violations_per_1000_totalpopulation,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN violations v ON t.geoid = v.geoid
LEFT JOIN population p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
